# Container image pull failing on new nodes

Newly scaled nodes cannot start pods; existing pods are fine.

The image pull secret expired and was only refreshed on the original node pool; new nodes joined without the valid registry credentials.

1. Confirm ImagePullBackOff and the 401 from the registry in pod events
2. Rotate and re-create the imagePullSecret in the namespace
3. Patch the service account to reference the new secret
4. Trigger a new node and confirm images pull successfully

Error Details
```
Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull and unpack image: 401 Unauthorized from registry; ImagePullBackOff
```

Tags: infra, kubernetes, imagepullbackoff, 401, registry-auth
